## Install

```sh
opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-subagent-explorer@dev --global
```

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- fix(attribution): hardened annotation parser excludes OpenCode's native (@agent subagent) title suffix (parity with AV); rows gain a title-annotation fallback validated against the sidecar alias set, attributing children beyond the attribution walk's depth; sidecar view now carries the full variant alias map (custom names, parent-key form, disabled excluded) ([`4cb392b`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-subagent-explorer/commit/4cb392bcd2a7bbf2d337c4ed196c2562da04de2c)) by @Mirrowel

opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-subagent-explorer@dev --global

### Fixes
- fix(core): paginated session listing (explicit 5000 limit - server defaults to a 100-row page, which truncated large trees and made cleanups miss everything past page 1), AV-parent children never hidden-badged (window-independent gate), attribution pages backward via before cursor (5x100), cleanup progress dialog + post-pass verification, error-envelope-aware deletes ([`ca4cd59`](https://github.com/Mirrowel/opencode-subagent-explorer/commit/ca4cd59b3e76d4369b475bec2c8a7ca55aaaef53)) by @Mirrowel
